QuestInfo.name: Lilishu, the Good Daughter
QuestInfo.0: Lilishu in Mu Lung was worried about something.
QuestInfo.1: Lilishu is worried over her father Mr. Ku who has become weak of late. Go get #r#t4033908##k for Lilishu who is worried over her father.
QuestInfo.2: You were moved by Lilishu's concerned for her aging father so you brought #t4033908# for Mr. Ku.

0.0: Do you know my father? People call him #rMr. Ku#k. He's fussy, but he has a big heart. He raised me all on his own after my mother passed away.
0.1: I think his age is starting to catch up with him though, especially with the weather changing. Do you think you could help?

yes.0: They say Bellflowers bear fruit when they are a thousand years old. This fruit makes you strong against heat, cold, and even illness. With just #r1 #t4033908##k, I won't ever have to worry about father's health again.

no.0: Oh, I guess I'm bothering you with my family troubles...

1.0: What business do you have with me?

yes.0: Lilishu put you up to this? My daughter is too good to me.

default.0: Lilishu is all grown up now. I could croak now with no regrets.

npc.0: Just #r1 #t4033908##k would make my father feel all better...
